question: Kailasanathar Temple is located in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Kailasanathar Temple is located in **Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu**, India.
 
• It was built during the **Pallava dynasty** by King Narasimhavarman II, also known as Rajasimha, in the 8th century CE.
 
• The temple is dedicated to **Lord Shiva** and is one of the oldest surviving temples in Tamil Nadu.
 
• The architecture of the temple is a classic example of **Dravidian style**, featuring intricate carvings and sculptures.
 
• The Kailasanathar Temple is renowned for its **sandstone construction** and is a significant monument reflecting early South Indian temple architecture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dravidian Architecture**

 
 
• It is a distinct architectural style that originated in South India and is characterized by pyramid-shaped towers called **vimanas**.
 
• Key features include intricately carved pillars, gopurams (gateway towers), and stone sculptures depicting Hindu deities.
 
 
 
• **Kanchipuram**
 
 
• Kanchipuram, also known as the "City of Thousand Temples," is one of the seven sacred cities in Hinduism.
 
• The city is famous for its ancient temples and hand-woven silk sarees.
 
 
 
• **Pallava Dynasty**
 
 
• The Pallavas ruled parts of South India from the 4th to 9th centuries CE.
 
• They were great patrons of art and architecture, contributing significantly to the development of temple architecture.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Lord Shiva Temples**
 
 
• Lord Shiva temples are considered vital in Hinduism as Shiva is one of the principal deities of the religion.
 
• These temples often include a **lingam**, a symbolic representation of Shiva, as the main deity.
